[[Dagnar Stonepate]] is the cousin of [[Jalis Ironhammer]] and the founder and original leader of the xenophobic [[Stone Summit]]. With the Stone Summit, he has begun a civil war in the [[Shiverpeak Mountains]] with the [[Deldrimor]] [[Dwarf|Dwarves]], enslaved many other races including [[Dolyak]]s, [[snow beast]]s, and [[human]]s, and aspires to rule all of [[Tyria]].

==Notes==
*The mounted model of this creature has a [[miniature]] [[Miniature Dagnar Stonepate|version]].
*In the Prophecies game manual, Dagnar Stonepate is called "Dagnar Stonesplitter."
*When together, Dagnar and his [[Drake]] have an [[Elementalist]] [[boss]] aura and Dagnar wields a [[wand]], but when the dwarf is on foot (during the end cinematic of [[the Frost Gate]] [[mission]]), he has a [[Warrior]] boss aura and wields a [[Summit Axe]].
**According to the Prophecies Prima Guide, as a warrior without his drake he is level 24.
